actual_scope: Prove the unique real origin minimizing the infinity norm of N(c)-I for every finite banded Gaussian chirp in the specified quadratic family; certify a strict improvement on the ten-vertex p=19 section.
scope_change_reason: This is a new conditioning optimization lemma motivated by James Reed PR4305, rather than an audit or discharge of a selected framework assumption.

stop_rule: Stop at the first proved strict origin improvement and its bounded exact corroboration. Do not extend to physical admission, other gauges or recursive Schur optimization.

open_questions.question: What is the best row-norm bound after imposing an explicit logarithmic range budget on the chirp diagonal?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The unconstrained optimum in the ten-vertex example has diagonal range exp(81*pi); conditioning alone does not pay for conversion or precision.
